notes: «كلاهما عن ابن نمير» is the convergence: both branches meet at ابن نمير, so that name and the rest are the shared tail
The second «قال ابن العلاء حدثنا ابن نمير، حدثنا هشام» repeats the same names for the second branch; read as the shared tail, not as a separate route
The «و» in «وأبو» and «ومحمد» is the conjunction and is not part of a surface
